Assess matched treatment effects within and across control sets

Source: R/assessment.R
assess_experiment.Rd

First computes each set-specific arithmetic MI ratio using melanization_coefficient(). Final descriptive coefficients average these ratios equally across sets for each treatment. They are not ratios against a pooled control. Inferential contrasts use raw colony MI, not ratios sharing a control denominator.

Usage

assess_experiment(
  colonies,
  control = "control",
  by = NULL,
  method = c("mixed", "plate_means"),
  level = 0.95,
  p_adjust = "holm",
  pool_contexts = FALSE,
  comparison_scope = c("matched_effects", "common_sets"),
  require_qc = FALSE
)

Arguments

colonies

Target colony table or batch result, with plate_id, set_id, treatment, colony_id and MI_mean. Raw pipeline results may include the central partner, which is excluded. Missing target values are errors.

control

Label identifying control plates.

by

Optional extra control-matching columns. A set cannot span different matching values. To pool multiple strains/days, explicitly justify that estimand; otherwise assess each biological context separately.

method

mixed (lme4/lmerTest) or plate_means (ordinary linear model on one arithmetic MI per plate). The latter is an explicit alternative, not a silent fallback after a problematic mixed fit.

level

Confidence level for unadjusted, contrast-wise intervals.

p_adjust

Multiplicity method passed to p.adjust; default Holm. Applied separately to within_sets, overall_effects and treatment_comparisons.

pool_contexts

Allow final pooling across different recorded strains, days or media. Default FALSE; subset to a context or explicitly justify pooling.

comparison_scope

matched_effects compares each treatment's own matched effects across its observed sets; common_sets restricts both to shared sets. Different set coverage is flagged and needs a comparability justification.

require_qc

Require recorded QC approval for every plate. Default FALSE warns on unconfirmed QC and retains its status in qc_review.

Value

List with coefficients, overall_coefficients, plate_means, within_sets, overall_effects, treatment_comparisons, model, diagnostics, and status. Mixed-model contrasts use Satterthwaite degrees of freedom. Sparse designs, singular fits and convergence problems return descriptive coefficients with no inferential tables. At least two independent plates per cell are required as a computational guard, not a sufficiency guarantee.

Details

The mixed model is MI ~ 0 + set-treatment cell + (1 | plate). It estimates a separate mean for every observed set-treatment cell and a random intercept for each plate. Within-set contrasts subtract the matching control cell. Overall contrasts average those differences equally over available sets. Pairwise treatment comparisons subtract the average matched effects of each treatment. Optionally restrict both treatments to their common sets. These effects refer to the observed sets, not a population of unobserved sets.

Assumes independent plates, approximately normal residuals and common residual variance. Inspect model residuals and the actual design. Pixels, radial rings and repeat photographs are not biological replicates. The model does not handle repeated observations of a plate over time. Shared control uncertainty is retained through the model contrast covariance; do not test exported ratios as if they were independent observations.
